blocks.source: ペルソナ3
blocks.translation: Persona 3

blocks.source: 当作品にはオリジナル版に加えて、後日談などの追加要素が加えられたＦＥＳ版が存在する。筆者はＦＥＳ版で本編をプレイ。ただし、後日談は未プレイ。（評判があまりよろしくないようなので……）
blocks.translation: In addition to the original version, this game also has an FES version with added content, including an epilogue. I played the main story in the FES version. However, I have not played the epilogue. (It doesn't seem to have a very good reputation...)

blocks.source: 実はこっちより先にペルソナ４を先にプレイしている。そのため、比較した上での不満点を多く記述している。もっとも、後発作品の方が評価が高いのは望ましいことだけど……。
blocks.translation: Actually, I played Persona 4 before this one. As a result, I have described many shortcomings based on comparisons between the two. That said, it is certainly preferable for a later entry to receive higher praise...

blocks.source: 物語／システム
blocks.translation: Story / System

blocks.source: ゲームシステムはペルソナ１，２と比較して、大きく変化。
blocks.translation: The game system has changed significantly compared to Persona 1 and 2.

blocks.source: 始終、学校を中心に物語は進む。高校に転校してきた主人公は仲間と交流を深めながら、『タルタロス』と呼ばれるダンジョンの探索を進めていく。
blocks.translation: The story consistently progresses around the school. While deepening their relationships with their friends, the protagonist, who has transferred to the high school, explores a dungeon called Tartarus.

blocks.source: という具合に、ペルソナ１，２に部分的に見られた学園青春物という方向に先鋭化したゲームデザインとなっている。これは、メガテン本シリーズとの差別化という点でも、理解できる方向転換だと思う。
blocks.translation: In this way, the game design has become more focused on the school coming-of-age theme that was partially seen in Persona 1 and 2. I think this is an understandable change of direction, as it also differentiates the game from the main Megami Tensei series.

blocks.source: ４と比べて最も優れている点は終盤から、ラスボス戦までのストーリー展開がしっかりしていること。学園的な行事は４と比べると少なめ。
blocks.translation: Its greatest strength compared to 4 is that the story development from the final stages through the final boss battle is solid. There are fewer school-related events than in 4.

blocks.source: このシリーズ共通の特徴だが主人公は喋らないＤＱ型。ただし、選択肢などに若干の個性が含まれているのが面白い。個人的にこういうタイプの主人公は好み。
blocks.translation: As is common to this series, the protagonist is a silent, Dragon Quest-style hero. However, it is interesting that the protagonist has a slight personality in choices and the like. Personally, I like this type of protagonist.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: System / Balance

blocks.source: 戦闘はシンボルエンカウント形式を採用。注意していれば、敵に先手を取られることはないため、メガテン３にあったバックアタックされると、一瞬で全滅のようなことはなくなった。
blocks.translation: Battles use a symbol encounter system. If you pay attention, enemies cannot catch you off guard, so you no longer get situations like the back attacks in Megami Tensei 3 that could wipe out your entire party in an instant.

blocks.source: 逆にザコ戦では、簡単に先手を取れるため、こちらの一方的な攻撃で終わることが多く単調になりやすい。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, in battles against weak enemies, it is easy to get the first strike, so they often end with one-sided attacks and can become monotonous.

blocks.source: 主人公が死ぬと、仲間が生きていても問答無用でゲームオーバーとなる鬼仕様。これはメガテン本シリーズと同じ仕様。ペルソナ１，２ではなかったはずだったのに……。
blocks.translation: If the protagonist dies, it is an unforgiving system that results in a game over even if the other members are still alive. This is the same system used in the main Megami Tensei series. I thought this wasn't the case in Persona 1 and 2...

blocks.source: クリティカルを受けると一気にピンチになるし、即死魔法を使う敵も多くいるなど、運の要素も大きい。メガテンシリーズ共通の特徴とはいえ、この辺は好みが分かれると思う。
blocks.translation: A critical hit can put you in a desperate situation at once, and many enemies use instant-death spells, so luck also plays a major role. Although this is a common feature of the Megami Tensei series, I think opinions will vary on this aspect.

blocks.source: ちょっとしたミスが命取りになりやすいバランスなのに、通常攻撃を外すと転ぶ仕様は理不尽。気軽に通常攻撃を使えないのは辛い。
blocks.translation: Despite the balance making even minor mistakes potentially fatal, the mechanic that makes you fall over when you miss a normal attack is unreasonable. It is frustrating that you cannot use normal attacks casually.

blocks.source: ＦＣのＤＱ４と同じように、仲間のコマンドが入力できない代わりに、個別に作戦を指定する形式。（『命令させろ』の様な作戦も存在しない）
blocks.translation: As in the Famicom version of Dragon Quest IV, you cannot enter commands for your party members; instead, you assign tactics to each of them. (There is no tactic like “Follow Orders,” either.)

blocks.source: しかし、ＤＱと違って、シビアなこのゲームには辛い。何より、ＡＩがお馬鹿なのでテンポの悪化とプレイヤーのイライラに繋がっている。
blocks.translation: However, unlike Dragon Quest, this is painful in such a demanding game. Above all, the AI is foolish, which slows down the pace and frustrates the player.

blocks.source: 例えば……
blocks.translation: For example...

blocks.source: ・一撃でとどめをさせる相手に状態異常やため技を使う。
blocks.translation: ・Uses status ailments or charge skills on an enemy that can be finished off with one hit.

blocks.source: ・敵が複数いても、全体魔法を使わず単体魔法を使う。（ＭＰと時間の無駄使い）
blocks.translation: ・Even when there are multiple enemies, uses a single-target spell instead of an area-of-effect spell. (A waste of MP and time.)

blocks.source: ・回復を使って欲しい場面で、補助を使う。（逆もあり）
blocks.translation: ・Uses support skills when you want it to heal. (And vice versa.)

blocks.source: （ＤＱでは、回復は「命を大事に」補助は「色々やろうぜ」というように作戦を分けているが、このゲームは回復と補助が同じ作戦に該当する。）
blocks.translation: (In Dragon Quest, tactics are divided so that healing corresponds to “Take Care of Yourself” and support corresponds to “Show No Mercy,” but in this game, healing and support fall under the same tactic.)

blocks.source: ……などなど。
blocks.translation: ...and so on.

blocks.source: これによって、使いやすいキャラと使いにくいキャラの差が出てしまっている。ＡＩがお馬鹿だと好きなキャラでも使いにくい。いらない魔法は使用禁止とかできれば良かったのだけど……。この程度のＡＩなら、普通にコマンド入力の方がよかったんじゃないかなと。
blocks.translation: As a result, there is a noticeable difference between characters who are easy to use and those who are difficult to use. Even a character you like can be difficult to use when the AI is foolish. It would have been nice if you could prohibit the use of unwanted spells... With AI this poor, I think simply entering commands would have been better.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: ・ロードはやや長めで回数も多い。
blocks.translation: ・Loading times are somewhat long, and there are many of them.

blocks.source: ・いちいち、仲間の装備を変えたり、回復魔法を使うのに仲間に話しかける必要がある。
blocks.translation: ・You have to talk to party members every time you want to change their equipment or use a healing spell on them.

blocks.source: ・メニューを開くのに２秒かかる。
blocks.translation: ・Opening the menu takes two seconds.

blocks.source: など、致命的なレベルの物はないが細かい欠点がチラホラ。
blocks.translation: There are no truly fatal flaws, but there are various minor shortcomings here and there.

blocks.source: また、このシリーズ共通の特徴であるが、相変わらずペルソナを使用した時の演出が少し長い。そこまで酷くはないものの、やはりＤＱ、ＦＦ、メガテン３などと比べると、テンポの悪さを感じてしまう。
blocks.translation: Another feature common to this series is that the animations when using Personas are still a little long. They are not unbearably bad, but compared to Dragon Quest, Final Fantasy, and Megami Tensei 3, the pace nevertheless feels sluggish.

blocks.source: 評価できる点として自動戦闘にすると、全員でスピーディに通常攻撃をしてくれるところが上げられる。ただし、通常攻撃をミスると転ぶ仕様のせいで気軽には使えないのだけど……。
blocks.translation: One praiseworthy point is that, when you switch to auto-battle, everyone performs normal attacks quickly. However, because missing a normal attack makes you fall over, it is not something you can use casually...

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: ボーカル付きでおしゃれな曲が多いのが特徴。通常戦闘曲はユニークで、この作品のオリジナリティを醸し出している。ラストバトルでは、シリーズおなじみのある曲を格好良くアレンジしている。
blocks.translation: The game is characterized by its many stylish songs with vocals. The regular battle theme is unique and gives the game its originality. In the final battle, a familiar series song is given a cool arrangement.

blocks.source: ただし、多くの時間を占めるダンジョン曲が単調なのはマイナス。一応、曲の変更なんてこともできるけれど、さほどのバリエーションがあるわけではないし、場面に合ってもいない。
blocks.translation: However, it is a drawback that the dungeon music, which occupies much of the playtime, is monotonous. You can change the music, but there is not much variety, and the alternatives do not suit the scenes particularly well.

blocks.source: その他
blocks.translation: Other

blocks.source: 当作品はＰＳＰに移植されている。女主人公が追加されるなど色々と変更がある模様。
blocks.translation: This game was ported to the PSP. Apparently, various changes were made, including the addition of a female protagonist.
